screens.label: Quality + Fast
screens.note: Quality-that-yields-fast: profitable, growing, low-debt companies already trending up near their highs. Feeds Confluence (as the Screener.in source) and Sniper (fundamental kicker).
screens.query: Market Capitalization > 1000 AND Return on capital employed > 18 AND Return on equity > 15 AND Debt to equity < 0.5 AND Sales growth 3Years > 12 AND Profit growth 3Years > 12 AND Current price > DMA 200 AND Current price > 0.85 * High price
